title: Write tests for ShoppingCart
prompt: shopping_cart.py has a working ShoppingCart class (add(name, price, qty), remove(name), total(), apply_discount(percent)). Write a test file named exactly test_shopping_cart.py with at least 4 test functions (names starting with test_) that cover: adding items and total, removing an item, applying a percentage discount, and removing a name that is not present (should be a no-op). Your tests must pass against the given implementation.
